initial_selection: Best saved main-arm selection over all methods by recomputed hierarchical online data objective plus unchanged proper support/gain/phase prior; no truth or holdout access
prior: Same proper bounded uniform physical coordinates and .5/.5 grid-level Bernoulli(.65)-conditioned support prior as main A0; independent truncated Gaussian gain/phase sigma .005. Contrast and radius independent proper uniforms on stated public bounds. Normalization constants common to candidate/no-op cancel; algorithmic TR damping is not statistical prior.

optimizer.selection: lowest recomputed extended-prior online objective among paid residual trials and saved-main no-op

finer.scope: descriptive independent holdout numerical audit, no new gate

noise_rule: Unchanged results/a0/preparation/DISCREPANCY_RULE.json; one-sided conservative envelope, not fitted degrees of freedom or posterior calibration
offline_access: All eight online selections must be terminal and durable before loading any offline truth or holdout
failures: All trials, paid data/J/theta, nonconvergence and failed reservations retained; no automatic expensive retry
